claim: The Building Permit checklist lists a notarized application letter; notarized Unified Building Permit Form with Civil/Architectural plans signed/sealed by a licensed Civil Engineer/Architect (5 accomplished form copies); Architectural, Civil/Structural, and Sanitary/Plumbing forms (3 form copies and 5 plan sets each). Civil/Structural plans identify a licensed Civil Engineer; Sanitary/Plumbing identifies a licensed Sanitary Engineer/Master Plumber. Architectural plans must be signed/sealed by the hired licensed professional.
